extract_random_constraints: extract random n-gram constraints from tab-separated source target reference files via stdin
extract_phrases_with_length: extract phrases of a specified length from target sentences in a reference file
extract_constraints_with_sos_eos: extract constraints from target text with optional start and end of sentence tokens
run_extract_cli: run the extract script with a specified number of phrases and phrase length via CLI
review_get_phrase: review the get_phrase function that extracts and removes a phrase from a word list
